notes: Akyem Abuakwa has no Cliopatria row. Two pages, both thin: no founding year, no area, no frontier, no coordinates, no war list (the page has nothing on Fante or Asante wars, on 1826 or on 1874). The infobox's 1730 conquest is the only dated gain; the Akwamu dossier calls the 1730-31 conquerors 'Akyem and their allies' and the Ashanti dossier has Akyem (Abuakwa, Kotoku) gains in 1742 and 1765 for the Ashanti, so Abuakwa and the Ashanti overlap in the page-silent years 1742-1851: a gap-filler with a page on Abuakwa under Asante rule should add that. Kyebi, Asamankese, Nyanawase and Praso are not in the gazetteer (Kyebi coordinates here are approximate). The 1852 end is the page's; the British were on the coast in the 1840s (Bond of 1844).
